emergencyAccessExclusion.description: Object ID of a permanent, non-PIM-managed emergency-access (break-glass) account for this role. This role's PIM policy must never govern the break-glass account. A future apply workflow must fail closed if this placeholder is still present.

notes: Demo input describing the intended PIM role-settings/activation policy for the Privileged Role Administrator directory role, which can itself manage PIM assignments and therefore requires the same rigor as Global Administrator. Not applied to any tenant by this repository. Before controlled deployment: (1) replace both placeholders, (2) confirm Entra ID P2 licensing, (3) verify the emergency-access account, (4) roll out only after the Conditional Access privileged-role MFA policy has been reviewed in report-only mode.
